user_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform using AWS. It should allow users to upload PDF documents securely, extract text using OCR, identify PII, and store the metadata in a graph database for relationship querying.
normalized_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform on AWS where users can securely upload PDFs, the system extracts text via OCR, detects PII, and stores extracted metadata in a graph database to enable relationship-based queries.

execution_plan.objective: Break down the AI document intelligence platform into discrete technical components: secure PDF upload handling, OCR text extraction, PII detection, graph database storage, and relationship querying capabilities.
Identify publicly available and open-source solutions for AWS-based PDF processing, OCR engines, PII detection libraries, graph databases, and metadata relationship management systems.
Assess each identified candidate solution against requirements for security, scalability, AWS integration, accuracy, maintenance status, and licensing compatibility.
Determine for each component whether to REUSE existing solutions, ADAPT open-source projects, or BUILD custom implementations based on evaluation results.

Create a detailed technical architecture blueprint specifying selected tools, AWS services, integration points, data flow, API contracts, and implementation phases for the document intelligence platform.
Validate the blueprint against security requirements, AWS best practices, scalability constraints, and verify that all components integrate cohesively without conflicts.
